# midpoint_object (Data Source)

Looks up one midPoint object of any type by oid or by name, e.g. a built-in archetype, so that configurations need not hard-code OIDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a built-in archetype by name instead of hard-coding its OID.
data "midpoint_object" "application" {
  type = "archetypes"
  name = "Application"
}

resource "midpoint_service" "crm" {
  name      = "CRM"
  archetype = data.midpoint_object.application.oid
}

# Read an object by OID; body holds its canonical content.
data "midpoint_object" "end_user" {
  type = "roles"
  oid  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000008"
}

output "end_user_description" {
  value = try(data.midpoint_object.end_user.body.description, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) REST collection type of the object, e.g. archetypes, roles or functionLibraries.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the object; it must match exactly one object of the type. Exactly one of oid and name must be set.
- `oid` (String) OID of the object. Exactly one of oid and name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `body` (Dynamic) The object content in canonical form, without its type wrapper, its oid, container ids and server-managed items. Protected strings (passwords and other secrets, clear, encrypted or hashed) are removed, with the containers left empty by that.
- `id` (String) The object OID.
